sources.label: Classic TV Commercials
sources.notes: User uploads of classic commercials and public service announcements. Mixed eras and countries; declares no licence.

sources.label: Commercials From The Vault
sources.notes: VHS Vault compilations of commercials recorded off air. Mixed eras and countries; many items are long compilations, which the splitter cuts.

sources.label: TV Ads
sources.notes: Commercials from recorded television, primarily in US markets.

sources.label: AdViews (Duke University)
sources.notes: Benton & Bowles agency archive, digitised for Duke University Libraries: agency masters, not off-air recordings.

sources.label: Retrontario
sources.notes: Ontario television recorded off air: commercials among bumpers, news and programme segments.

sources.label: Retro Vancouver
sources.notes: Vancouver-area television recorded off air, from VHS.

sources.label: RetroTVNewYork
sources.notes: New York television recorded off air, mostly the 1970s: station IDs, promos, bumpers and local commercials. A few cartoons and off-market IDs.

sources.label: The Scott Vincent Archive
sources.notes: One New York station's material: station IDs, movie opens, promos and news, some of it whole newscasts, which the splitter cuts.

sources.label: Philly-Jersey Girl
sources.notes: Philadelphia and South Jersey television recorded off air: local commercials, station IDs, bumpers and promos, tagged with station and air date.

sources.label: Garbage Pail Flix VHS
sources.notes: Chicago late-night commercial breaks and bumpers recorded off air, with some cable and network breaks.

sources.label: TelevisionDetroit
sources.notes: Detroit television recorded off air: station promos, news promos and local commercials.

sources.label: Junkie's Tape Bin
sources.notes: Albany-Schenectady-Troy television recorded off air: commercial breaks, news opens and some whole newscasts.
